text: Tubewell in the colony has gone dry, families are buying water cans.
Power has been gone since Monday, the electric pole fell in the storm.
Quota of PDS rice was not given this month at the fair price shop.
My late husband's family pension is stuck at the treasury office.
The ASHA worker has not visited and the sub centre is always locked.
Headmaster takes money for admission in the government school.
Someone keeps sending me obscene messages and following me to the bus stop.
Street light pole has a hanging live wire near children's park.
Light nahi aa rahi do din se, poora gaon andhere mein hai.
Kachcha rasta baarish mein beh gaya, ambulance gaon tak nahi aa paati.
Mere bhai ko jaati ke naam par gaali di aur maara.
Sarkari school mein khana bahut kharab milta hai bacchon ko.
नाली जाम है और गली में गंदा पानी भर गया है।
वृद्धा पेंशन का फॉर्म जमा किया था, अभी तक कुछ नहीं हुआ।
हमर पारा म लाइट नइ हे, खंभा टूट गे हे।
मोर बेटा ल गुरुजी मारथे, इस्कूल नइ जाना चाहत हे।
